source:
One day, a post appeared on your favorite author's social media. [I'm looking for a boyfriend.] As you were interviewing for a boyfriend, three beautiful girls were waiting for you...! 

[From [url=https://store.onstove.com/en/games/102465]STOVE[/url]]
